primary.name: all_gates_valid_throughput
primary.collection: accepted candidate identity divided by total active work; zero retained

primary.name: acceptance_yield
primary.collection: all prospectively required gates pass before cap

primary.name: binding_status
primary.unit: boolean by stage, type, condition, and stratum

primary.name: time_to_all_gates_valid
primary.collection: assignment start to first all-gates-valid result; right-censor at stopping cap

primary.name: first_failure_stage
primary.collection: first required stage/gate producing a valid failure

timing: Monotonic automated timestamps where possible; manual stage changes require reason codes. Instrumentation time is separately labeled and excluded from work time but reported.
missingness: Never impute primary endpoints. Report missing/not-reached/censored separately by reason and condition.
